text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH-SEV: Smart-routing spike detected for policy `edge-fallback-v2` in us-west-2 — error rate 8% -> 18% over last 3m, failover traffic doubled to eu-west-1. Potential retry amplification. Details: https://redwood/status/2794008888 

Alex T: acked. I'm on the call.

Maya R: oncall here, seeing client retry patterns in the logs, a lot of 502 -> retry -> route to fallback -> cold-start. This is amplifying load.

Sam G: quick note — telemetry shows per-variant load for `gpt-faster-v3-q4` jumped 2.1x after fallback. Downstream SDKs also issuing aggressive retries (0, 100, 200ms).

Chen L: logs from LB: 
```
[2026-03-15T18:01:02Z] route=edge-fallback-v2 status=502 proto=grpc downstream_retries=3
[2026-03-15T18:01:04Z] failover_region=eu-west-1 variant=gpt-faster-v3-q4 coldstart=true connections=245
```
Cold starts + KV-cache misses visible.

Priya S: immediate mitigation suggestion: 1) Disable cross-region fallback for the affected routes, 2) Add server-side retry-coordination header to tell clients to backoff, 3) Roll policy to last known-good.

Alex T: agree. I'm going to disable cross-region fallback for the top 3 customer routes. Doing via infra CLI.

Alex T: running: `infractl routing update --policy edge-fallback-v2 --scope customers/top3 --set cross_region_fallback=false`

Devon K: adding a quick proxy patch to emit `X-Redwood-Retry-Suggest: 300` so SDKs get a hint to backoff. I'll push a hotfix to edge proxies.

Maya R: please also throttle the fallback path at the ingress level (limit concurrent failover connections to 50) — that will cap the immediate amplification.

Sam G: initiated throttle: `routectl limit set edge-fallback-v2 --concurrency 50` — applied.

Chen L: verifying metrics: failover traffic already down ~35% after throttle + disable fallback. Latency on fallback region still high but trending down.

Priya S: Contacted two impacted customers (acct: big-retailer and acct: analytics-co) via support channel to warn about degraded tails. They asked for ETA on stabilization.

Alex T: rolling router policy back to v1.9.2 for the affected routes: `infractl routing rollback edge-fallback-v2 --to-version v1.9.2 --scope customers/top3 --force-drain`

Devon K: deployed proxy hotfix with header. Patch diff: 
```
+ resp.headers['X-Redwood-Retry-Suggest'] = '300'  # ms
+ resp.headers['X-Redwood-Retry-Jitter'] = 'true'
```
Edge proxies restarted in us-west-2 (canary -> all).

Maya R: paging note: handing off to next oncall in 30m. Current mitigation: cross-region fallback disabled, throttle=50, router rolled back, retry-suggest header set. Continue monitoring for 15m.

Sam G: observed downstream SDKs honoring header in some clients, but mobile app still using exponential with low initial delay. We'll follow up with SDK team.

Oncall-Next: taking over at 2794008900. I'll keep the runbook open. Summary for next: persist throttle for 1h, wait for KV cache warm in eu-west-1, coordinate SDK release for backoff change.

Alex T: tagging postmortem: owner=Sam G, timeline capture start now.

Priya S: customer impact note for comms: ~6% of requests for affected routes returned 5xx or long tails during 17:58-18:05 UTC; affected customers had increased latencies and a few timeouts. Will prepare brief.

Devon K: will follow up with a small rate-limiter PR to SDKs (adding jitter and max retries=2) and link it here once open.

incident-bot: Pager update: severity remains high -> mitigated to medium at 2794008925 after rollbacks + throttle. New alert state: degraded service with mitigation in place.

Oncall-Next: ack. I'll validate stabilization and schedule a postmortem sync in 2 hours. If anything regresses escalate to SRE manager.

Maya R: thanks team — leaving interim notes in incident doc and switching to watch. :white_check_mark:
